lines.en: I hang under a leaf, swaying with the twig.

lines.zh: 我没有脚，只能被风带着摇。
lines.en: I have no feet; only the wind moves me.
I am fixed to this leaf's underside.
When the twig moves, I swing.
I am harder than I was a few days ago.
I cannot choose where to go.
Rain strikes and I rock.
I press to the leaf, quite steady.

lines.zh: 风从下方来，把我托起一点。
lines.en: The wind comes from below and lifts me a little.

lines.zh: 我一整天都挂在这个位置。
lines.en: I hang in this spot all day.

lines.zh: 我的外壳上有细细的棱。
lines.en: Fine ridges run over my casing.
I have turned slowly.
The leaf sinks under my weight.

lines.zh: 我被叶子遮住，晒不到太阳。
lines.en: The leaf hides me from the sun.
I sway twice more and stop.
I cannot move, and need not.
I hang there, very quiet.
The part inside never stops changing.
My color is a pale green.
I feel the weather change.
I eat nothing.

lines.zh: 里面的翅膀已经折好了。
lines.en: The wings inside are already folded.
I am no longer a caterpillar.
My casing grows thinner.
Insects are calling outside.
My hold is very firm.
I know you are below me.
You are reaching to touch me.
Do not squeeze; it is still soft inside.
I hang low enough for you to see clearly.
Your shadow has taken the light.
I cannot come out yet.
Give me a little more time.
Touch me and I will fall.
I hear you breathing.
Why do you not leave?
Another seam has opened on my shell.

lines.zh: 壳里那部分疼得蜷起来。
lines.en: The part inside my shell curls up in pain.
Something inside shrank.
I may fall.
That pain made me clench.
I cannot make a single sound.
The leaf has been dragged into a curl.
I did not come off the leaf.
Let it be over soon.
I have no mouthparts at all.
There is no mouth on this shell.
You hold a leaf; I do not need it.
All I need now is time.
That is of no use to me.
I cannot even put my head out.
Please put it back.
Wait until I come out on my own.
It means nothing to me.
You push the leaf and I swing wildly.

lines.zh: 你碰得枝叶乱晃，我贴紧叶脉。
lines.en: You shake the branch; I grip the leaf vein tight.

lines.zh: 我的壳已经硬了，不易破。
lines.en: My casing is hard now; it will not break easily.
I nearly got shaken off.
I slowly settle back to hanging.
Do not shake this thin twig.
Something inside shifted.
I held on and did not fall.
That left me a little dizzy.
Step back a little, please.
I am still wrapped in this shell.
Not at this stage.
Wait until I come out myself.
There are no wings inside this shell.
This time is only waiting.
This is not what I am yet.
There will be other butterflies later.
I cannot give you an answer.
I only grow inside.
Something landed on the leaf.
It weighs the leaf down further.
I cannot reach it at all.
It will slide off, surely.
It is pressed against me.
I spend the time waiting.
It fell off the leaf.
It presses on me uncomfortably.
I sense something coming near.
I have not one recourse.
My casing tightened suddenly.

lines.zh: 如果被吃掉，也只能认了。
lines.en: If I am eaten, that is that.
The part within shifted once.
Little time remains.
I heard that sound.
The leaf is aquiver.
I draw myself tight.
I am fixed to this leaf.
I sway because of the wind.
I cannot see where you are.
I can feel that patch of dark.
I cannot run a single step.
It is very crowded inside.
The distance will not change.
I stay hanging under this leaf.
You have not left that spot.
Any later and it will be too late.
I have no means at all.
I have neither teeth nor claws.
All I can do is endure it.
A seam has split in my casing.
Something in the shell shifted.
The blow leaves me hanging sideways.
I cannot even struggle.
This shell can only hang.
I am still hanging on this thread.
Please leave this place.

lines.zh: 叶背上多了一个小小的蛹。
lines.en: A small chrysalis appears on the leaf's underside.
I have only just finished changing.
I hang beside the leaf vein.
The light is soft here.
The silk holds me very firm.
My casing still takes a fingerprint.
The air outside is damp.

lines.zh: 我第一次听见树的声音。
lines.en: I hear the tree for the first time.

lines.zh: 我看不见，但我知道离地多高。
lines.en: I cannot see, but I know the height.
And so I hang.
The heat bakes me brittle.

lines.zh: 我从叶上掉下来，落在草里。
lines.en: I fall off the leaf into the grass.

lines.zh: 爆风把叶子连我一起掀飞。
lines.en: The blast rips the leaf away with me.

lines.zh: 有东西把叶子打了个洞。
lines.en: Something punched a hole through the leaf.

lines.zh: 一股力让我的壳变脆了。
lines.en: Some force makes my casing brittle.

lines.zh: 我没有嘴，可我也在耗尽。
lines.en: I have no mouth, yet I am running out.

lines.zh: 雷声震得我整个都木了。
lines.en: The thunder rattles me numb.

lines.zh: 我掉进一个没有尽头的空处。
lines.en: I fell into a place with no end.
